$comment: Per-policy mode for the Jev policy extensions: off | shadow | enforce. Shadow logs decisions to agent/jev-audit without changing behaviour. guard.bash.scope: strict (every destructive command is screened) | system-only (only actions on operating-system and protected folders ask; /guard-scope switches it for the running process). Promotion evidence: jev-lab/profiles/policies.md. Read at session start; restart OMP after editing. A file that cannot be parsed makes every policy enforce.
